title: Bounded state from a frame
statement: Let the word bound be $W$, let $\text{args}$ be a finite list of integers, and let $\mu:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$. If every entry of $\text{args}$ and every value of $\mu$ has absolute value at most $W$, then the state whose location function lists the entries of $\text{args}$ in order and is $0$ beyond the list, and whose memory function is $\mu$, has all location and memory values bounded in absolute value by $W$.
